title: DataFlowBench real-project pin v1
description: One selected repository of the real-project confirmation slice, pinned by immutable revision and source-archive digest. Written during preregistration, before any analyzer runs against the repository. See docs/real-project-preregistration.md.

schema_version.description: Pin-record schema version. A freeze that binds real-project evidence records this value.

pin_id.description: Stable pin identity, by convention dfb-rp-<language>-<repository slug>. Never renamed or reused.

wave.description: The rollout wave that admitted this pin. R1 is the first real-project slice.

stratum.description: The sampling stratum the repository was drawn from. Strata are per-language and are drawn independently.

language.description: The repository's language for scoring purposes. Equal to the stratum by eligibility criterion E1.

ecosystem.description: The advisory ecosystem the frame query used for this stratum.

advisory.description: The advisory that placed the repository in the frame. It supplies the candidate defect, never a ground-truth verdict.

selection.description: How the draw reached this repository. The validator recomputes draw_key from the seed and the advisory id, so a repository cannot be substituted into the slice by hand.

fix_commits.description: Every fix commit the advisory names in this repository, resolved to full revisions and ordered by commit date.

revisions.description: The two pinned revisions. They form the candidate positive/negative pair; whether the pair is minimally different is an adjudication question, not a schema one.

file_path.description: Repository-relative path of the license file, as it exists at the pinned vulnerable revision.

ground_truth.description: Ground truth is authored and adjudicated by reviewers, never inherited from the advisory and never derived from an analyzer result.

review_independence.description: Whether this case's ground truth was reviewed by someone other than its author. `maintainer-only` means the separation the preregistration's review procedure requires was waived, and the scorecard must say so beside every number derived from this case. It is a property of the record so that the disclosure cannot be lost between the review and the report.
